visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a black top, cheers enthusiastically into a handheld camera. She is positioned in a crowded outdoor stadium at night, with bright floodlights overhead. Dozens of long pink paper ribbons fall from the sky like rain, filling the frame with movement. (2) The camera shifts to a close-up of the woman's face as she laughs and screams in joy, her eyes wide and squinted. Behind her, other fans are seen blurred, some holding up smartphones to record. The pink ribbons continue to drape over the crowd and the woman herself. (3) The camera pans across the stadium seating area, revealing thousands of fans waving their arms and throwing more pink ribbons. A large red arch structure and a bright electronic screen are visible in the background. (4) The woman is shown again in a medium shot, rhythmically chanting along with the crowd. She holds a pink ribbon in her hand and pumps her arm in the air, her face reflecting high energy and excitement against the dark night sky.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: One main female creator in the foreground, with more than 20 distinct fans visible in the background stadium seats.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with long black hair, wearing a casual black short-sleeved top and holding a smartphone.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A professional baseball stadium at night, featuring tiered seating filled with fans, large red structural beams, and bright electronic billboards.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An immediate explosion of thunderous crowd cheering and high-pitched screaming. The acoustic energy is concentrated in the high-frequency range, indicating extreme vocal arousal. A closer female voice is heard shouting in pure excitement. (2) The chaotic cheering transitions into a rhythmic, low-frequency chant. Thousands of voices unite to shout 'Kuo-Fu-Chi' in a synchronized 4/4 cadence. The background noise floor is saturated with the resonant roar of the stadium. (3) The chanting continues with high intensity, punctuated by the sharp sound of whistles and the rustling of ribbons hitting the camera or surrounding fans. No BGM is present, only the raw, distorted field recording of the event.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To capture and share the raw emotional peak of a live sports celebration, specifically the moment of victory characterized by the tradition of throwing pink ribbons at a CTBC Brothers baseball game.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-energy selfie-style vlog format to immerse the viewer in the stadium atmosphere. The high level of audio distortion and shaky camera work enhance the feeling of authentic, spontaneous joy.
